test_vfs_lifecycle: test the PyMjVFS class by creating, initializing with mj_defaultVFS, and deleting with mj_deleteVFS
test_vfs_file_operations: test VFS file handling by adding, finding, and deleting files using mj_addFileVFS, mj_findFileVFS, and mj_deleteFileVFS
create_vfs_instance: create a PyMjVFS instance and initialize it with functions.mj_defaultVFS before use
add_file_to_vfs: add a file to the VFS using functions.mj_addFileVFS with a directory path and file name
find_file_in_vfs: find a file in the VFS using functions.mj_findFileVFS and check the returned index
